title: Rank Foundation Foods by one nutrient (April 2023)
purpose: Rank the Foundation Foods in this FoodData Central release by their amount per 100 g of one nutrient, highest or lowest first, with each food's FDC id, description, food category, the nutrient's name and unit and the amount. Foods without a published amount for the nutrient are left out. Ties order by description, then FDC id. Each food and nutrient pair has one amount in this release. This release publishes no food categories, so food_category is always empty.

parameters.name: nutrient_id
parameters.description: Nutrient id in this release (fdc-food-nutrients-2023-04 lists them, for example 1003 protein or 1162 vitamin C)

output_columns.name: fdc_id
output_columns.description: FoodData Central id of the food

output_columns.name: food_category
output_columns.description: Empty: this release publishes no food categories

output_columns.name: amount
output_columns.description: Amount per 100 g of the food, as published
